this comment for the release after. -->

## Fixed

- **A silent mic says so.** When the microphone sends nothing at all (blocked in privacy settings, muted, or the wrong input picked), Murmur now says "Your mic is silent" instead of "Didn't catch that", which sounded like you should speak up.

## Changed

- **On a Mac, the pill shows only while you dictate.** The little box at the top of the screen used to stay there all the time, on every desktop and over full-screen apps. It now appears when you press the talk key and goes away once your words land. The menu bar icon is still there for everything else.
